info.title: B2B Quote, Invoice & CLIN Table Extractor API
info.description: Stateless B2B & GovCon FinOps extraction microservice that transforms messy multi-tier pricing tables, Federal RFP Section B CLIN/SLIN schedules, Time & Materials (T&M) labor rate cards, commercial vendor quotes, invoices, and Bills of Materials (BOMs) into normalized JSON with automated Quantity x Unit Price math verification, Base vs. Option Year subtotals, and Price-to-Win (PTW) negotiation intelligence.

post.summary: Extract and Audit Multi-Tier Pricing Tables, Federal Section B CLINs, Rate Cards & BOMs
post.description: Accepts unstructured text from a Federal RFP Section B CLIN schedule, B2B vendor quote, commercial invoice, T&M labor rate card, or Bill of Materials (BOM) and returns a normalized JSON pricing schedule with Base vs. Option Year subtotals, per-line unit/extended math verification, and FinOps / Price-to-Win negotiation insights.

SECTION B - SUPPLIES OR SERVICES AND PRICES/COSTS (SOLICITATION FA8732-26-R-0041)
Vendor: Sentinel GovCloud Solutions LLC | Buyer: USAF Enterprise IT Directorate
Payment Terms: Net 30 via WAWF / IPP.
CLIN 0001 (Base Year - FFP): FedRAMP High Cloud Landing Zone Managed Platform | Qty: 12 Months | Unit Price: $28,500.00/mo | Extended: $342,000.00
CLIN 0002 (Base Year - T&M): Senior Zero-Trust Cloud Architect (GSA LCAT) | Qty: 1,920 Hours | Rate: $185.00/hr (10% discount off $205.56 GSA list) | Extended: $355,200.00
CLIN 0003 (Base Year - T&M): DevSecOps Automation Engineer | Qty: 1,920 Hours | Rate: $155.00/hr | Stated Extended Total: $305,000.00
CLIN 0004 (Base Year - Cost Reimbursable): CONUS Mission Travel & ODCs | Qty: 1 Lot | Unit: $25,000.00 | Extended: $25,000.00 (No NTE ceiling specified)
CLIN 1001 (Option Year 1 - FFP): FedRAMP High Cloud Landing Zone Managed Platform | Qty: 12 Months | Unit Price: $29,355.00/mo | Extended: $352,260.00
CLIN 1002 (Option Year 1 - T&M): Senior Zero-Trust Cloud Architect (3% escalation) | Qty: 1,920 Hours | Rate: $190.55/hr | Extended: $365,856.00

payment_terms_and_invoicing_rules: Net 30 via Wide Area Workflow (WAWF) / Invoice Processing Platform (IPP)
Hybrid billing: Monthly FFP platform invoicing (CLIN 0001/1001) + T&M hourly burn (CLIN 0002/0003/1002)

line_items.description_or_labor_category: FedRAMP High Cloud Landing Zone Managed Platform
FedRAMP High Cloud Landing Zone Managed Platform

math_and_pricing_anomalies.finding_description: Arithmetic extension error: 1,920 Hours x $155.00/hr equals $297,600.00, but the schedule states an extended total of $305,000.00 (+$7,400.00 overcharge discrepancy).
math_and_pricing_anomalies.recommended_remediation: Require vendor to revise CLIN 0003 extended total down to $297,600.00 (reducing Total Evaluated Contract Value to $1,737,916.00) prior to contract award.

math_and_pricing_anomalies.finding_description: Cost-reimbursable travel/ODC line item ($25,000.00) lacks an explicit Not-To-Exceed (NTE) ceiling and JTR/FAR 31.205-46 per-diem incorporation.
math_and_pricing_anomalies.recommended_remediation: Convert CLIN 0004 to 'Cost Reimbursable - Not-To-Exceed (NTE) $25,000.00' subject to FAR 31.205-46.

example.finops_and_price_to_win_summary: Hybrid FFP/T&M schedule totaling $1,745,316.00stated ($1,737,916.00 corrected). Blended T&M labor rate across Base Year is $170.00/hr with a reasonable 3.0% annual escalation into Option Year 1. Correcting the $7,400 math error on CLIN 0003 and applying the 10% GSA discount benchmark from CLIN 0002 onto CLIN 0003 yields $37,160.00 in immediate deal-desk savings.
